description: Baseline Model A (1.0 ATR act / 1.0 ATR trail)
Exit immediately at bar index of deviation if experienced, else 48b expiry
Exit when either trailing stop hits OR deviation occurs (whichever first)
Exit when trailing stop hits ONLY IF deviation also occurred
If deviation occurs within first 12 bars, tighten trail from 1.0 to 0.5 ATR
